title: [SOA] Clear stale pricing notifications on item availability refresh
summary: Sales Order Agent now clears stale pricing-error notifications when refreshing item availability results, preventing outdated errors from remaining visible after a successful search on the same page.
key_points: Pricing-error notification is recalled at the start of result refresh in the Multi Items Availability page
Prevents stale notifications from persisting when subsequent searches succeed
New pricing failures encountered during result reading can still send notifications
No changes to pricing rules, item selection, or subscription billing validation
Limited to notification lifecycle management without schema or permission changes
